description:
The silent enrollment of the children of imported care contracts
(EnrollContractChildren, #7760, ADR 0309) for one child with one coming
pickup exception, composed with the resync of the pickup auto excusals as in
production. Enrollment's own statements stay flat as children grow; Care
Plan's per-child approval building blocks and excusal resync add an exact
residual the test asserts (31 per child here).
